narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack tangled · EMA spread -2.74 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 89.430-90.833 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 91.682; the first objective pays 1.41R at 90.410.

plan.triggerRule: await bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 89.430-90.833
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 91.682 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
